Container.Name: botsu
Container.Overview: Lean self-hosted chat bot for Discord and Fluxer: YouTube upload and Twitch live alerts, with moderation and music planned. Replaces Red-DiscordBot without Java/Lavalink. All settings come from the env file in Extra Parameters (see .env.example in the repo); no ports are needed.
Container.Requires: A root-only env file at /mnt/user/appdata/secrets/botsu.env with at least DISCORD_TOKEN or FLUXER_TOKEN (no quotes around values), and /mnt/user/appdata/botsu owned by 99:100.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database: alert subscriptions and what has already been posted. Must be writable by 99:100.
